scientific_integrity: Definitions and interval normalization match the one-jump benchmark in Caldera 2026 §5.1; distinct from the universal discrete reverse Hardy inequality, which remains open here.
scientific_limitations: The result computes the infimum over one-jump indicator sequences only; it does not prove the conjectured inequality for all nonincreasing sequences. Analytic tail bounds plus an exact finite rational certificate complete the infinite optimization.
title: Exact one-jump constant in the discrete reverse Hardy–BMO problem
